T: Snap out of it and eat.
D: A Brooklyn widow falls for her fiancé's angry baker brother under a big full moon.
P: Bring out the bread when Ronny is in the bakery basement.
S: warm bread from Ronny's bakery, the Cammareri Bros. ovens

Thick olive oil focaccia dimpled with rosemary and flaky salt, baked crisp-bottomed and torn warm at the table with peppery oil. Mix 500g bread flour, 7g dried yeast, 10g salt and 400ml warm water into a wet dough. Cover and rise 2 hours. Oil a 30 x 20cm tin with 60ml olive oil, tip in the dough and stretch to the corners. Rest 30 minutes, then dimple deeply with oiled fingers. Scatter with rosemary leaves and flaky salt and drizzle with 30ml oil. Bake at 230C for 22 to 25 minutes until deep golden.
Loretta's breakfast: a red capsicum ring and an egg in toast
Cut a hole in thick white bread, fry in butter, drop a thick ring of red capsicum in the pan with an egg inside it, cook until the white sets. Salt and pepper.

Thin salami and provolone, olives warmed with orange peel and fennel seed, and roasted capsicum dressed in garlic oil. Char 2 red capsicums under a hot grill for 15 minutes, turning, then cover in a bowl for 10 minutes. Peel, slice and dress with 1 sliced garlic clove, 2 tbsp olive oil and salt. Warm 200g mixed olives in 1 tbsp oil with 2 strips orange peel and 1 tsp fennel seeds for 3 minutes. Arrange with 100g thinly sliced salami and 100g provolone on a platter.
M: the restaurant where the whole family keeps running into each other
Linguine with clams steamed open in garlic, chilli and white wine, finished in the juices with parsley and olive oil.
Thin chicken breast floured and seared, lemon, white wine and butter pan sauce with capers and parsley.
W: Drained ricotta with icing sugar and orange zest piped into shells at the last minute, chocolate-dipped ends.
K: Loretta's family, bottle of wine and a full moon
Amaretto shaken with lemon and egg white until frothy, poured over ice with a cherry.

dishes.make_ahead: Best the day it is baked; keeps 1 day airtight

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, salt and warm water into a wet dough. Cover and rise for 2 hours.
Oil a 30 x 20cm tin with most of the oil, tip in the dough and stretch to the corners. Rest for 30 minutes.
Dimple deeply with oiled fingers, scatter with rosemary and flaky salt and drizzle with the remaining oil.

ingredients.item: red capsicum, cut in 4 thick rings

steps.text: Cut a hole in each slice of bread.
Melt the butter in a big pan and lay in the bread. Put a capsicum ring in each hole and crack an egg into it.
Fry until the white sets, flipping the bread once. Season.
Slice the chicken in half horizontally and pound thin.
Dust in flour and sear in the oil and butter for 2 minutes a side, then set aside.
Add the wine, lemon juice and capers, reduce by half and swirl in the cold butter and parsley.

dishes.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day ahead; fill shells just before serving

ingredients.item: icing sugar, plus extra for dusting

steps.text: Drain the ricotta in a sieve for 2 hours.
Beat with icing sugar and orange zest, then fold in the chocolate.
Pipe into the shells just before serving and dust with icing sugar.
Shake the amaretto, lemon juice and egg white hard without ice, in rounds for two drinks at a time.
Strain over fresh ice in four short glasses and add a cherry to each.

s.how: Mix 500g bread flour, 7g dried yeast, 10g salt and 400ml warm water into a wet dough. Cover and rise 2 hours. Scatter with rosemary leaves and flaky salt and drizzle with 30ml oil. Bake at 230C for 22 to 25 minutes until deep golden.

s.note: Loretta's breakfast: a red capsicum ring and an egg in toast
s.how: Cut a hole in 4 thick slices white bread. Melt 40g butter in a big pan and lay in the bread. Put a thick ring of red capsicum in each hole, crack an egg into it, and fry until the white sets, flipping the bread once. Season with salt and pepper.

m.how: Slice 2 large chicken breasts, about 600g, in half horizontally and pound thin. Dust in flour and sear in oil and 20g butter for 2 minutes a side, then set aside. Add 100ml white wine, the juice of 1 lemon and 2 tbsp capers, reduce by half and swirl in 40g cold butter and parsley. Return the chicken to coat.

w.how: Drain 500g fresh ricotta for 2 hours, then beat with 80g icing sugar and the zest of 1 orange. Dip the ends of 8 cannoli shells in 50g melted dark chocolate and let set. Pipe in the filling just before serving.

d.note: Loretta's family, bottle of wine and a full moon
d.how: Shake 45ml amaretto, 25ml lemon juice and half an egg white hard without ice, then again with ice. Strain over fresh ice in 4 short glasses and add a cherry to each.
